row:
Learn how to self treat with: self massage, stretching, and exercises from Dr. Malka's videos!

Do you want to self treat other pain issues?  Hit that SUBSCRIBE button 
to see more videos and tell me what areas you would like me to address.

To learn more about me go to www.drbrendamalka.com or read below:

I have 22 years of clinical experience. 
My education includes: 2 years of education in myofascial trigger point therapy, a doctorate in Chiropractic,and another 4 years for a masters in Acupuncture and Asian medicine. 
 Acupuncture for muscle pain is also called "dry needling"
